official.deadline_note: No closing date is published because the scholarship is assessed automatically when you apply to study at Griffith University.
official.application_cycle: Rolling, assessed on admission; apply for Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027
official.status_note: There is no application window: Griffith assesses eligibility when you apply to study and advises the outcome in your Letter of Offer under 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The award value is published as '20% of tuition fees' and 'Scholarship applies to tuition fees only'.
benefits: If awarded the scholarship in your letter of offer, the deposit displayed will be a reduced amount to reflect the 20% scholarship
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Have a minimum GPA in previous studies of 4.5 on a 7 point scale or equivalent
Satisfy all academic and English language entry requirements for your chosen undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
Be a full-time student starting in Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027
requirements: Students must be International Fee Paying to qualify for the scholarship and each deduction; any change from that status withdraws the scholarship
Students must be enrolled full-time and making progress meeting student visa requirements, unless credit prevents full-time enrolment
Students must pass all courses for each trimester of study and successfully progress to enrol in the next trimester
Students must remain enrolled in the program for which the scholarship offer was made
Scholarship recipients approved for an internal transfer must meet full-time enrolment requirements and have passed all prior courses to retain the scholarship
selection_criteria: No separate application and no competitive panel: the award is assessed on admission against the published GPA threshold
If a student is awarded a Griffith University scholarship worth more than 20% of tuition fees, the higher-value scholarship applies instead
coverage: 20% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees only, for the duration of the program
Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered
application_method: Apply to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at Griffith University
Griffith assesses your application for scholarship eligibility
If successful, you are advised in your Letter of Offer, in 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'
official.application_route: No separate scholarship application: apply to study at Griffith and the 20% reduction is assessed automatically and shown in the Letter of Offer.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicant must be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students only; Australian and New Zealand citizens are excluded.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Most undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs. Excluded programs: Bachelor of Medical Science, Bachelor of Dental Health Science, Doctor of Medicine, Master of Dentistry, Master of Speech Pathology, MBA, Graduate Diploma of Flight Management, Higher Degree Research, non-award, Study Abroad, Diploma programs, Masters Qualifying Program, Griffith English Language Institute programs, part-time-only programs, and partner-delivered programs.
official.research_requirement: Not applicable to this scholarship; Higher Degree Research programs are excluded.
official.duration: Valid for your whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing eligibility requirements
official.description: Griffith University's International Academic Merit Scholarship recognises international students with strong academic results applying for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs, with an award value of 20% of tuition fees, and is assessed automatically as part of your application to study.

not_confirmed: funding_amount, funding_currency, funding_period - the value is published only as a percentage (20% of tuition fees), with no dollar figure
documents - none are required because there is no separate scholarship application
english_requirement - the page requires program English language entry requirements but publishes no IELTS/TOEFL score or MOI rule
travel_coverage - no travel or relocation benefit is published
verification.notes: Award value, automatic assessment route, GPA threshold of 4.5, commencement intakes, the program exclusion list and all ongoing enrolment conditions were read directly from Griffith University's own scholarship page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is the low-friction option: there is nothing extra to submit, because Griffith assesses the 20% tuition reduction when it processes your application to study. The result is not signalled through a separate letter but appears inside your Letter of Offer under 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees', so read the fee section of your offer carefully rather than looking for a scholarship email. If you also hold or are being considered for a higher-value Griffith scholarship, the higher one takes precedence and this 20% is not stacked on top.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International applicants with a GPA of 4.5 or above on a 7-point scale who want an automatic tuition reduction without a competitive scholarship process.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your GPA converts to at least 4.5 on the Griffith 7-point scale using the published GPA conversion criteria before accepting an offer
Check that your intended program is not on the exclusion list, which includes the MBA, medical, dental, speech pathology and flight management programs
Plan to commence in Trimester 3 2025 or any trimester of 2026 or 2027; deferring to 2028 or later voids the award
Read the Letter of Offer fee section line by line to confirm the 20% deduction and the reduced deposit have been applied
Keep your International Fee Paying status intact, since any change ends the scholarship
common_rejection_risks: Deferring commencement to 2028 or later, which makes the scholarship void
Applying to an excluded program and assuming the discount still applies
Losing International Fee Paying status, which withdraws the scholarship even mid-degree
Failing a trimester or not progressing to the next one, which ends the deduction
Being on a packaged offer with a pathway provider and expecting the discount before final grades are provided to Griffith
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Roughly 80% of your tuition fees for the whole degree, plus all living costs, accommodation, health cover, flights and visa costs.
document_audit: No scholarship documents are required, so the quality of your admission application and transcripts is what determines the award
For packaged offers, the assessment only happens once final grades are provided to Griffith, so do not expect the discount on your pathway offer
The reduced deposit in the Letter of Offer is your only visible evidence that the scholarship has been applied
alerts: The award can quietly lapse if you defer to 2028 or later, so any deferral decision should be checked against the scholarship terms first
An internal transfer requires both full-time enrolment and all prior courses passed, so changing programs is not risk-free
This is not stackable with a higher-value Griffith scholarship, so do not build a budget on both
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit your application to study at Griffith, then check the 'Tuition and other fees - Total period fees' section of your Letter of Offer to confirm the 20% deduction was applied.
